corrections.observed: The first revalidation invocation had not loaded the restored private Python setup before importing the pinned ITk identity module.
corrections.resolution: Load the restored private Python setup after the pinned LCG setup and before every Python identity check; add a command-order regression test.

corrections.observed: The first stop check expected raw JSON, while gh-axi intentionally returned a structured safe rendering.
corrections.resolution: Request a bounded base64 JSON projection through gh-axi, require its non-truncated marker, and decode it before trusted issue validation.

corrections.observed: A no-op authenticated stop read refreshed generated timestamps even though durable control state was unchanged.
corrections.resolution: Write campaign snapshots only when a stop request changes durable state; add a clean-tree boundary check.
